shortDescription: Configure Infoblox DNS Nameserver Authoritative Groups

options.name: comment
options.description: Configures a text string comment to be associated with the instance of this object.  The provided text string will be configured on the object instance.

options.name: extattrs
options.description: Allows for the configuration of Extensible Attributes on the instance of the object.  This argument accepts a set of key / value pairs for configuration.

options.name: external_primaries
options.description: Configures a list of external nameservers (non-members of the grid). This option is required when setting I(use_external_primaries) to C(true).

options.name: external_secondaries
options.description: Allows to provide a list of external secondary nameservers, that are not members of the grid.

options.name: grid_primary
options.description: This host is to be used as primary server in this nameserver group. It must be a grid member. This option is required when setting I(use_external_primaries) to C(false).

options.name: grid_secondaries
options.description: Configures the list of grid member hosts that act as secondary nameservers. This option is required when setting I(use_external_primaries) to C(true).

options.name: is_grid_default
options.description: If set to C(true) this nsgroup will become the default nameserver group for new zones.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the NIOS nameserver group to be managed.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: Configures the intended state of the instance of the object on the NIOS server.  When this value is set to C(present), the object is configured on the device and when this value is set to C(absent) the value is removed (if necessary) from the device.

options.name: use_external_primary
options.description: This flag controls whether the group is using an external primary nameserver. Note that modification of this field requires passing values for I(grid_secondaries) and I(external_primaries).
